mapper.sql: WITH booking_stats AS ( SELECT b.venue_id AS venueId, b.venue_customer_id AS customerId, SUM(CASE WHEN b.status IN ('CONFIRMED','COMPLETED','NO_SHOW','ENDED_UNTRACKED') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS validBookingCount, MAX(CASE WHEN b.source='ONLINE' AND b.status='COMPLETED' THEN b.completed_at END) AS lastCompletedAt, MAX(CASE WHEN b.source='ONLINE' AND b.status='COMPLETED' THEN ver.verified_at END) AS latestVerifiedAt, SUM(CASE WHEN b.status='CONFIRMED' AND b.start_at > UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS futureConfirmedCount FROM s_booking b LEFT JOIN s_verification ver ON ver.booking_id=b.id WHERE b.venue_customer_id IS NOT NULL AND b.venue_id=#{venueId} GROUP BY b.venue_id,b.venue_customer_id ), ranked_valid_bookings AS ( SELECT b.venue_id AS venueId,b.venue_customer_id AS customerId,b.start_at AS bookingAt, b.source AS bookingSource, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY b.venue_id,b.venue_customer_id ORDER BY b.start_at DESC,b.id DESC) AS rankValue FROM s_booking b WHERE b.venue_customer_id IS NOT NULL AND b.venue_id=#{venueId} AND b.status IN ('CONFIRMED','COMPLETED','NO_SHOW','ENDED_UNTRACKED') ), latest_valid_bookings AS ( SELECT venueId,customerId,bookingAt,bookingSource FROM ranked_valid_bookings WHERE rankValue=1 ), usual_hour_counts AS ( SELECT b.venue_id AS venueId, b.venue_customer_id AS customerId, HOUR(CONVERT_TZ(b.start_at,'+00:00','+08:00')) AS hourValue, COUNT(*) AS countValue FROM s_booking b WHERE b.venue_customer_id IS NOT NULL AND b.venue_id=#{venueId} AND b.status IN ('CONFIRMED','COMPLETED','NO_SHOW','ENDED_UNTRACKED') GROUP BY b.venue_id,b.venue_customer_id,hourValue ), usual_hours AS ( SELECT venueId,customerId, GROUP_CONCAT(CONCAT(hourValue,':',countValue) ORDER BY countValue DESC,hourValue ASC SEPARATOR ',') AS usualHours FROM usual_hour_counts GROUP BY venueId,customerId ), tag_names AS ( SELECT tr.venue_id AS venueId,tr.customer_id AS customerId, JSON_ARRAYAGG(t.name) AS tagNames FROM s_venue_customer_tag_relation tr JOIN s_venue_customer_tag t ON t.id=tr.tag_id AND t.venue_id=tr.venue_id WHERE tr.venue_id=#{venueId} GROUP BY tr.venue_id,tr.customer_id )

vc.id AS customerId,vc.venue_id AS venueId,u.contact_name AS contactName,u.phone, COALESCE(bs.validBookingCount,0) AS validBookingCount, vb.bookingAt AS lastValidBookingAt,vb.bookingSource AS lastValidBookingSource, bs.lastCompletedAt,bs.latestVerifiedAt, COALESCE(bs.futureConfirmedCount,0) AS futureConfirmedCount, uh.usualHours,tn.tagNames,vc.created_at AS customerCreatedAt
mapper.select: SELECT FROM s_venue_customer vc JOIN s_user_account u ON u.id=vc.user_id LEFT JOIN booking_stats bs ON bs.venueId=vc.venue_id AND bs.customerId=vc.id LEFT JOIN latest_valid_bookings vb ON vb.venueId=vc.venue_id AND vb.customerId=vc.id LEFT JOIN usual_hours uh ON uh.venueId=vc.venue_id AND uh.customerId=vc.id LEFT JOIN tag_names tn ON tn.venueId=vc.venue_id AND tn.customerId=vc.id WHERE vc.venue_id=#{venueId} AND vc.id=#{customerId}

SELECT id,venue_id AS venueId,name,created_by_admin_id AS createdByAdminId, created_by_employee_id AS createdByEmployeeId,created_by_name AS createdByName,created_at AS createdAt FROM s_venue_customer_tag WHERE venue_id=#{venueId} ORDER BY name,id
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM s_venue_customer_tag WHERE venue_id=#{venueId} AND id=#{tagId}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM s_venue_customer WHERE venue_id=#{venueId} AND id=#{customerId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM s_venue_customer_tag WHERE venue_id=#{venueId} AND id=#{tagId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM s_venue_customer_tag_relation WHERE venue_id=#{venueId} AND customer_id=#{customerId} AND tag_id=#{tagId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM s_venue_customer_tag_relation WHERE venue_id=#{venueId} AND customer_id=#{customerId} AND tag_id=#{tagId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO s_venue_customer_tag_audit(venue_id,customer_id,tag_id,tag_name,action, actor_admin_id,actor_employee_id,actor_name,occurred_at) SELECT tr.venue_id,tr.customer_id,tr.tag_id,t.name,'UNASSIGNED_BY_TAG_DELETE', #{createdByAdminId},#{createdByEmployeeId},#{createdByName},UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) FROM s_venue_customer_tag_relation tr JOIN s_venue_customer_tag t ON t.id=tr.tag_id AND t.venue_id=tr.venue_id WHERE tr.venue_id=#{venueId} AND tr.tag_id=#{tagId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM s_venue_customer_tag_relation WHERE venue_id=#{venueId} AND tag_id=#{tagId}
mapper.sql: f.id,f.venue_id AS venueId,f.customer_id AS customerId,u.contact_name AS contactName, f.purpose,f.source_group AS sourceGroup,f.status,f.note, f.created_by_admin_id AS createdByAdminId,f.created_by_employee_id AS createdByEmployeeId, f.created_by_name AS createdByName,f.created_at AS createdAt, f.handled_by_admin_id AS handledByAdminId,f.handled_by_employee_id AS handledByEmployeeId, f.handled_by_name AS handledByName,f.handled_at AS handledAt, CASE WHEN f.handled_at IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM s_booking b WHERE b.venue_id=f.venue_id AND b.venue_customer_id=f.customer_id AND b.status IN ('CONFIRMED','COMPLETED','NO_SHOW','ENDED_UNTRACKED') AND b.start_at > f.handled_at) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS rebookedAfterHandled, (SELECT b.start_at FROM s_booking b WHERE b.venue_id=f.venue_id AND b.venue_customer_id=f.customer_id AND b.status IN ('CONFIRMED','COMPLETED','NO_SHOW','ENDED_UNTRACKED') AND b.start_at > f.handled_at ORDER BY b.start_at,b.id LIMIT 1) AS rebookedAfterHandledAt, (SELECT b.source FROM s_booking b WHERE b.venue_id=f.venue_id AND b.venue_customer_id=f.customer_id AND b.status IN ('CONFIRMED','COMPLETED','NO_SHOW','ENDED_UNTRACKED') AND b.start_at > f.handled_at ORDER BY b.start_at,b.id LIMIT 1) AS rebookedAfterHandledSource
mapper.select: SELECT FROM s_venue_customer_followup f JOIN s_venue_customer c ON c.id=f.customer_id AND c.venue_id=f.venue_id JOIN s_user_account u ON u.id=c.user_id WHERE f.venue_id=#{venueId} AND f.status=#{status} ORDER BY f.status,f.created_at DESC,f.id DESC
SELECT FROM s_venue_customer_followup f JOIN s_venue_customer c ON c.id=f.customer_id AND c.venue_id=f.venue_id JOIN s_user_account u ON u.id=c.user_id WHERE f.venue_id=#{venueId} AND f.id=#{id}

SELECT FROM s_venue_customer_followup f JOIN s_venue_customer c ON c.id=f.customer_id AND c.venue_id=f.venue_id JOIN s_user_account u ON u.id=c.user_id WHERE f.venue_id=#{venueId} AND f.customer_id=#{customerId} AND f.purpose=#{purpose} AND f.status='PENDING'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO s_venue_customer_followup(venue_id,customer_id,purpose,source_group,status, created_by_admin_id,created_by_employee_id,created_by_name,created_at) SELECT vc.venue_id,vc.id,#{purpose},#{sourceGroup},'PENDING', #{createdByAdminId},#{createdByEmployeeId},#{createdByName},UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) FROM s_venue_customer vc WHERE vc.venue_id=#{venueId} AND vc.id=#{customerId} AND (SELECT MAX(b.completed_at) FROM s_booking b WHERE b.venue_id=vc.venue_id AND b.venue_customer_id=vc.id AND b.source='ONLINE' AND b.status='COMPLETED') <= UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM s_booking future_booking WHERE future_booking.venue_id=vc.venue_id AND future_booking.venue_customer_id=vc.id AND future_booking.status='CONFIRMED' AND future_booking.start_at > UTC_TIMESTAMP(3))
mapper.update: UPDATE s_venue_customer_followup SET status=#{status},note=#{note}, handled_by_admin_id=#{handledByAdminId},handled_by_employee_id=#{handledByEmployeeId}, handled_by_name=#{handledByName},handled_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE venue_id=#{venueId} AND id=#{id} AND status='PENDING'
